items.source: Canonical name of the target type that owns the scheduled method.
items.translation: Canonical name 是拥有已调度方法的主体类型的。

items.source: Name of the method that is executed for the scheduled task.
items.translation: 执行定时任务的方法名称。

items.source: Name of the exception thrown during task execution, or "none" if no exception was thrown.
items.translation: 任务执行期间抛出的异常名称，如果没有抛出异常则为 "none"。

items.source: Outcome of the scheduled task execution.

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。
